newsitem.title: USA: US stocks rally higher on opening as bonds surge.
newsitem.headline: US stocks rally higher on opening as bonds surge.

text.p: Wall Street stocks rallied higher at the opening following lower than expected retail sales figures and the seventh straight month of falling producer prices.
The Dow industrials rallied more than 50 points higher in the first few minutes, helped by the pre-market rally in bonds which soared more than a percentage point.
The Dow was up 71.77 points 8032.61, with Nasdaq up 19.56 at 1595.80 points. NYSE arbitrage curbs were set at 0938 EDT.
The long bond was up 1-2/32, pushing the yield down to 6.59 percent as fears over inflation and interest rate hikes subsided, analysts said.
